_source.upstream: upstream mcoimg-v3-codec.global.js, meshcore-open docs commit c38c1650fe8394835e333b5b4a1ac84ead2d5e5a (MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 zjs81)
_source.decode: Pillow 12.3.0: convert RGBA, Lanczos to longest side 512 (bench/gen_src.py); lineart is drawn by gen_src.py
_source.pipeline: area-average resize (premultiplied, exact box coverage), matte on white round(c*a+255*(1-a)), nearest RGB (first index wins) - gen_photo.js, mirrors compose/resize.ts+quantize.ts
commands: node gen_photo.js <upstream mcoimg-js dir> probe bench/photo_select.json
node gen_photo.js <upstream mcoimg-js dir> build bench/photo_select.json bench/photo_raw.json bench/raster_in.json
_source.note: pixels are profile colour ids. compressionLevel normal|high; packetNonce fixed per entry. High entries kept only when upstream took <= 3 s (upstreamMs from the probe run, cap 30 entries; selection frozen in bench/photo_select.json so regeneration is byte-identical). bodyBase64/text include the nonce.
